verdicts.reason: A breaks the original single-row banner into a stray diagonal: the headline floats at x≈120 near the top and the Shop button drops to the lower centre, so the two sit on different axes with no shared edge, and the headline is undersized with large dead purple areas around it. B keeps the original left-text, right-CTA row and is the more faithful resize, but the row sits in the upper half and leaves an empty band below. Its button stops about 80px short of the right edge while the headline nearly touches the left margin, and the headline is still too small for the 768×198 canvas.
